## What lives here
The workflow engine: definitions and models, validation, step runners, the local DAG engine and executions, prerequisites, reviews, argument wiring and conforming, output contracts, the expression sandbox and dry runs.

## Conventions
<!-- Naming, file layout, patterns every file here follows (e.g. "one router per resource", "hooks start with use"). -->

## Entry points
`engine.py` and `step_runners.py` (also used by compiled Mistral workflows).
